source_snapshot.procedure: Install approved CMake dependencies, obtain clpeak, initialize its submodules, build with CMake and run `./clpeak`.
source_snapshot.criteria: All required results meet the project specification without build, runtime or system issue.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL calls for a generic clpeak harness but omits the live clone/submodule supply chain, exact build, device enumeration and metric parsing.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies toolchain and sustained-load dependencies but supplies neither provenance nor a source-equivalent workflow.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds pinned commits/checksums, approved dependencies, OpenCL device scope, full build/run output, thresholds and timeout/thermal controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Other GPU stress tests can support platform health but cannot replace clpeak's OpenCL metric set.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Rejects live `submodule --remote` execution while retaining the original build-and-benchmark intent.

original_test_intent: Build the approved clpeak revision and measure required OpenCL peak compute/bandwidth metrics for every expected GPU against the project AMD specification.
original_method: Fetch pinned source and submodule commits, build in an isolated directory with the approved toolchain, verify stable device mapping and run one complete clpeak pass with full tables and platform monitoring.
manual_activity: Engineer approves source/toolchain/device/metric policy; operator supervises sustained load and recovery; engineer decides the final DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Pinned clpeak and every submodule commit/hash/license
Required metric names/units and per-device thresholds
Build isolation, maintenance, cooling/power, timeout/abort and OOB policy
safety_requirements: Do not execute live or remotely advancing source
Verify all artifact hashes and dependency provenance before build
Build in an isolated path and drain GPU workloads
Preserve complete results and verify devices return to idle
agent_execution_scope: Fetch/build only pinned approved artifacts with full logs
Verify binary identity and expected OpenCL devices
Run one bounded clpeak pass and parse every required table/metric
Do not choose source revisions/specs, run unreviewed code or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve artifact/dependencies/device map and metric thresholds
Resolve build, enumeration, result or platform errors

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic harness description is not enough to execute or prove the source clone/build/run workflow and metric coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Build the pinned clpeak/submodule revisions with approved CMake/OpenCL/ROCm, verify devices, then run the resulting `./clpeak` once and retain all tables.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The clpeak build/execution purpose and source 20/30 timing are preserved; remote-moving revisions are replaced only by approved immutable identities.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a reproducible build manifest and stable-device metric matrix with units, thresholds and correlated health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures the supply chain and makes acceptance measurable without changing benchmark coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No generic aggregate score may replace the complete required clpeak outputs.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Results depend on clpeak/OpenCL/driver versions, so reference thresholds must match the pinned stack.

project_override_considerations: Project authority may approve a mirrored binary only with equivalent revision/build/device/metric traceability; it may not authorize an unpinned remote update implicitly.
expected_evidence: Source/submodule commits, hashes/licenses and dependency versions
Complete CMake/build outputs, exits and binary hash
Exact run output/exits/timestamps and every required metric/spec comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and Criteria consistently define clpeak build/run and spec comparison. Unpinned live sources and absent thresholds are security/readiness gaps rather than competing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Pinned artifacts, dependencies and limits can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Transforms a live supply-chain build into an immutable, reproducible and guarded per-device OpenCL metric validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: `git submodule update --remote` can change code independently of the parent revision, so neither the binary nor results are reproducible without pinning every commit. OpenCL enumeration order can also shift, requiring stable GPU identity. Complete per-metric output is essential because one peak path may pass while another device or datatype fails.
